Bettina Kroll, the official change of hands was **November 3, 2025**. Moss's Coastal digest from Nov 2 said ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Your own Dec 8 cutover recap also gives Nov 3 as the official handoff.

There's a second date you might see. You kept running the account day to day through Nov 21 to finish the terminal cutover, and Kwame fully took over operationally on Nov 22. For the coverage tracker, Nov 3 is the official date and Nov 22 is when Kwame took over day to day.
